observed_contents: R123 salvage compiles locally with XeLaTeX, two passes, 457 pages according to package README/checks.
Integrated fixes include P12 formula punctuation, P13 footnote/index and Heun wording, P16 alpha notation, P20 formula tag (12), and P39 pp.189-194 source-fidelity block plus refinements.
R122 rollup and P10/P12 reconcile are retained to document the path into the R123 salvage, not as parallel current branches.
